description:
Outcome: Each of approximately 80 club members signs in with an individual club account, from the owner's setup instructions.
Scope: Django URLs/settings/templates, session login/logout, admin-only account provisioning and password reset, migrations and authenticated Booking ownership with explicit safe mapping of legacy free-text members. Excludes: public signup.
Acceptance: Two accounts work independently; anonymous requests redirect; member identity is resolved server-side; mutations use CSRF; clean migration succeeds; existing free-text bookings require explicit mapping and unresolved records block migration rather than guessing ownership.
Behaviour: Accessible labelled forms, generic invalid-login errors, safe logout, authorization failures and no silent legacy data loss.
Verification: make test for login/access, clean and legacy migrations, mapping and rollback; document local setup. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: Staff provisions accounts; no evidence of deployed data; Django/SQLite retained.
title: Individual accounts and Django foundation
